case_title: Gulab Das & Ors. v. State of M.P.
mitigating_circumstances: Settlement between the parties, substantial part of sentence already served, parties are related
trial_court_outcome: Convicted for some offences, acquitted for others
neutral_facts: A dispute over the partition fence between two brothers' properties led to a fight. Both parties sustained injuries, resulting in the registration of cross cases against each other. The case against the accused was registered under Sections 307, 325, and 323 of the IPC, while the case against the opposite party was registered under Sections 325, 323, and 294 of the IPC. Separate charge sheets were filed, and the trial court acquitted the accused for some charges while convicting them for others. The accused were sentenced to imprisonment for a period of one month under Section 323 IPC, with additional sentences of three years' rigorous imprisonment and a fine of Rs.500/- under Section 307 IPC. The sentences were directed to run concurrently.
